Kavya (CSM): Kicking off prep for LatticeCare QBR — focus: token econ + renewal risk. Figured we'd do a quick snapshot, a spike scenario, and an enablement session. Thoughts?
Matt (FinOps): Thanks. Can we get a 90d token burn and projected runway M/M? Quick back‑of‑envelope: avg daily tokens ~4.5M => ~135M/30d. At $0.0008/token => est ~$108k/mo. Need to verify with real data.
Devin (Data): I can run the query. Will pull last 120d, bucket by feature (embed vs gen) and output percentiles. SQL I'll run: ```SELECT feature, SUM(tokens) as tok, AVG(cost_per_token) as cpt FROM usage WHERE account='latticecare' AND ts > now() - interval '120 days' GROUP BY feature;```
Lina (AM): @Kavya heads up — customer mentioned a new vector search rollout in April. That + embeddings could create a 1.5-2x embedding spike for a month.
Kavya (CSM): Noted. For slides we need: 1) current burn 2) forecast with spike scenario 3) alert thresholds & runbook 4) enablement one-pager and proposed session.
Matt (FinOps): Propose soft alert at 25% of committed credits, hard at 10%. Also propose an autoscaling cap: block embeddings >1.2M/day without approval. Thoughts on numbers?
Devin (Data): Query done. Raw last30d: gen=72,300,000 tokens, embed=38,100,000 tokens. Embeds cost ~1.8x per token vs gen. Uploading CSV to /shared/qbr/latticecare_tokens.csv now.
qbr-bot: CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sheets/qbr/latticecare_tokens.csv — automated baseline forecast (+15%) has been appended.
Kavya (CSM): @Devin can you add two forecast variants: a) 2x embedding month (one-off spike) and b) steady 6% QoQ growth? Need explicit $ and months for slide 3.
Devin (Data): Yep — running both scenarios, will include token-to-dollar mapping based on model mix. ETA ~2h, will comment here when uploaded.
Lina (AM): Also capture customer enablement ask: 1-hr session on batching/kv-cache + prompt templates and a one-pager on low-effort changes they can do. Can we produce that?
Matt (FinOps): I'll draft a one-pager with quick wins: increase batch size, enable prefix caching, quantization toggle for embeddings, and recommend default batch thresholds. Will share by EOD.
Kavya (CSM): Action items: Devin (forecast variants + CSV), Matt (one-pager + thresholds doc), Lina (coordinate enablement slot with customer), Kavya (assemble QBR slides). I'll circulate a draft by tomorrow 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:
Devin (Data): Assigned. I'll ping when forecasts are uploaded and attach CSVs.
Matt (FinOps): Created monitoring config: `budget.alerts.latticecare` in staging. Will wire webhooks to Slack channel and test using `--test-payload`.
Kavya (CSM): Please add a `snooze_window` so alerts can be muted during the enablement demo to avoid noise. @Matt
Matt (FinOps): Done — `snooze_window` flag added. Will annotate the QBR slide and include instructions to toggle in Console.
Lina (AM): Tentatively booked Wed 3pm PT for the enablement session; I'll confirm with customer and update calendar.
Kavya (CSM): Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. I'll compile the slide deck with the CSV graphs + alert runbook and share for review by 10am tomorrow. /cc @Devin @Matt
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR checklist item added — "Cost scenarios + enablement one-pager" assigned to Kavya, due in 18 hours.
